motion._doc: FluidNC linear rail for accelerometer stimulus.

_hardware_notes.sigma5_c0: Asset tracker device with LIS2DE12 accelerometer, BMP388 pressure sensor, ZOE-M8 GPS. No biometrics.
_hardware_notes.pressure: BMP388 barometric pressure sensor for altitude.
_hardware_notes.gps: u-blox ZOE-M8 GPS module via SPI.
_hardware_notes.charger: GPIO-controlled battery charger + Qi wireless charging.
_hardware_notes.fuel_gauge: MAX17055 fuel gauge for battery monitoring.
_hardware_notes.no_leds: No RGB status LEDs on Sigma5.
_hardware_notes.no_ppg: No PPG/VSM biometric sensors on Sigma5.
